intelligence.enrichment: Density is the mass present in a unit volume of a substance, so density equals mass divided by volume; its unit depends on the mass unit and volume unit used. For a given volume, greater mass gives greater density; for a given mass, greater volume gives lower density. The learner correctly applies this rule: Density is the mass present in a unit volume of a substance, so density equals mass divided by volume; its unit depends on the mass unit and volume unit used. Density is just the mass number, so a 27 g block has density 27.
